benchmark_source: pytest benchmarks/ops/bench_any.py --collect-only -q -> workloads_to_params('AnyFwdOp', include_extra=True) (manifest reduction.yaml AnyFwdOp.workloads + bench_any.py extra.setdefault('dim', -1)); collected 6 cases: smoke-any-bool, smoke-any-float16, smoke-any-float32, mask-validation-4k-bool, mask-validation-32k-bool, 3d-multidim-reduce-bool
accounting_note: manifest dtype=bool, but the Op layer pre-converts to float32 (to_logical_float32) BEFORE the kernel, so the kernel reads 4 B/element and writes 1 B/element (int8 carrier). msprof op meters only the kernel ('main'). All latency targets, byte figures and roofline ratios in this workspace use the actual kernel f32 bytes below. The manifest/report 'bytes' column (1 B/element for bool) is recorded for the ledger only and is never used as a criterion.
